name: Lauki Moong Broth
ingredients: 300 g lauki (bottle gourd), peeled and cubed
¼ cup (50 g) split moong dal, rinsed
steps: Simmer the moong with turmeric and water for 10 minutes.
Add the lauki and cook for 10 minutes until both are soft.
In a small pan, heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then add ginger and tomato and cook for 3 minutes.
Mash the dal and lauki lightly, stir in the tomato tempering and salt.
Add the tofu cubes for the last 3 minutes.
Simmer for 3 minutes and serve with coriander.
note: A very light, easily digested broth; suitable as a first meal after fasting or illness.
